test_objective: Redact a patient first and last name in a labeled field.
Redact a patient name in a narrative history sentence.
report_input: Patient Nadia Kimathi presents for follow-up of a lung nodule.
expected_output: Patient [PERSONALNAME] presents for follow-up of a lung nodule.

test_objective: Redact a patient name written LAST, FIRST in capitals.
Redact a relative's name in a results-communication sentence; keep the relationship word.
report_input: Results discussed with the patient's daughter, Maria Lopez, by telephone.
expected_output: Results discussed with the patient's daughter, [PERSONALNAME], by telephone.

test_objective: Redact patient initials when labeled as the patient's.
Redact a provider name containing an apostrophe and a hyphen.
report_input: Study ordered by Dr. Sean O'Brien-Walsh.

test_objective: Redact the signing radiologist's name; keep the credential.
report_input: Electronically signed by: Elena Fischer, MD

test_objective: Keep disease and anatomic eponyms that look like surnames.
report_input: Findings consistent with Hodgkin lymphoma; no Baker cyst.
expected_output: Findings consistent with Hodgkin lymphoma; no Baker cyst.

test_objective: Keep radiology eponyms that look like surnames.
report_input: Chiari I malformation with 6 mm tonsillar ectopia; Schmorl node at L2.
expected_output: Chiari I malformation with 6 mm tonsillar ectopia; Schmorl node at L2.

test_objective: Keep eponymous device and sign names.
report_input: Foley catheter in place; positive sonographic Murphy sign.
expected_output: Foley catheter in place; positive sonographic Murphy sign.

test_objective: Redact an uppercase doctor name while keeping the title.
report_input: Study ordered by Dr. JOHN SMITH.

test_objective: Redact a full street address with unit, city, state and ZIP; redacting the state with it is permitted.
report_input: HOME ADDRESS: 14 Juniper Lane, Apt 3B, Flagstaff, AZ 86001

test_objective: Redact a street address in a narrative sentence, including the house number.
